bands.name: Aural STL and intercity relay, 944 to 952 MHz
bands.note: stack stl; the raster is the 25 kHz segments, the first centred on 944.0125 MHz; a link stacks segments to at most 300 kHz, or 500 kHz for twenty segments; 942 to 944 MHz is kept for stations licensed before 21 November 1984 and is not in this band
